facts.fact: Alexandra Jakubowski joined StackAdapt's Product Marketing Team in 2019, after previously working as a solo marketer at an innovation consulting firm.
facts.quote: In 2019, I made the leap into adtech with StackAdapt, joining the Product Marketing Team which spearheads our go-to-market initiatives

facts.fact: The blog post states that the Product Marketing Alliance is a global community of more than 20,000 product marketing managers, a third-party figure cited by the author.
facts.quote: a global community of 20,000+ product marketing managers

facts.fact: The StackAdapt 'Life in Adtech' blog post featuring Alexandra Jakubowski was published on October 23, 2020.
